versions.changelog:
Initial release of Datadog Dashboard Builder.

- Guides users in designing Datadog dashboards and monitors from scratch or auditing existing ones.
- Recommends metrics, widget layouts, alert thresholds, and SLO definitions tailored to service types and criticality.
- Provides detailed dashboard layout patterns and widget configuration best practices.
- Includes templates for common alert monitors and guidelines for SLO targets by service tier.
- Offers a systematic dashboard audit checklist to improve observability and reduce noise.
